verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms turbopuffer serves a real llms.txt at turbopuffer.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, docs index content), and docs pages are published as agent-friendly markdown (e.g. quickstart.md, vector.md, write.md, api-overview.md). A public OpenAPI spec is also linked from the docs, although it is flagged as primarily internal and subject to breaking changes. Missing for 10: no explicit agent-usage guidance or llms-full.txt bundle evidenced, and the root docs.md returns 404.
